fields.description: The Narjes Ledger theme's accent — drives every primary button, link, active sidebar item, and "done" status color across the whole system, in both light and dark mode.
fields.label: Accent Color

fields.description: Scales text across the desk. Raise it for staff who find the default type hard to read.
fields.label: Font Size

fields.options: Takes effect on next page refresh — no rebuild needed. Light/dark mode itself is switched from the user menu (top right) and follows the system theme by default; this setting only controls the accent color used in whichever mode is active.

fields.description: Pick one color — a matching hover shade, tint, and dark-mode variant are derived automatically and contrast-checked.
fields.label: Accent Color
Show AI Order Intake Section by Default

fields.description: Applied to Sales Orders / Invoices / Delivery Notes when governorate of delivery is Baghdad.
fields.label: Baghdad Delivery Fee

fields.description: Applied when governorate of delivery is set and is not Baghdad.
fields.label: Other Governorate Delivery Fee

fields.options: All fields above are live: delivery fees are used on every Sales Order / Sales Invoice / Delivery Note, and the painting rate / sheet rate / default packaging cost are read directly by the canvas/sheet costing calculation and the packaging-cost default (see api.py's sales_order_before_validate / sales_order_validate). Change a value here and it takes effect on the next order — none of these are hardcoded in code anymore.

fields.description: Items counted in pieces turn red in the Items Balance report at or below this balance.
fields.label: Low Balance Threshold (pieces)

fields.description: Same warning for items measured by length, which run in far larger numbers than pieces.
fields.label: Low Balance Threshold (centimetres)

fields.description: Shown on the Home Dashboard's Quick Shortcuts section. Leave Role blank to show a shortcut to everyone; set it to only show that shortcut to users with that role.
fields.label: Quick Shortcuts

fields.options: Pick a Workspace per row, then a Link Type and Link To (autocompletes from actual Pages/DocTypes/Reports). Every Workspace that has at least one row here gets its sidebar fully rebuilt from those rows whenever this form is saved. Workspaces with no rows here are left untouched.

fields.description: How each month's net profit is divided. The shares below should add up to 100%; the dashboard warns you if they do not.
fields.label: Revenue & Salaries

fields.description: Kept aside for hard situations — a printer breaking, and days like it.
fields.label: Emergencies Box %

fields.description: Each partner's share of the same net profit.
fields.label: Profit Shares

fields.description: Paid on every item ticked 'Pays Commission' on the Item form. Recorded as a real monthly expense, so it comes out of profit before the shares above are worked out.
fields.label: Piece Commission
